messages:
mira (open-source): @here We just published redwood-inference-adapters v0.1.0 to GitHub and PyPI :tada:

mira (open-source): TL;DR: adapter layer for model checkpoints, simplified quantization helpers, and a migration shim from the legacy runner. Install: `pip install redwood-inference-adapters==0.1.0`

release-bot: release published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference-adapters/releases/tag/v0.1.0 — CI: ✅ all checks passed

dan (eng-runtime): Congrats! Any breaking changes we should warn Dedicated customers about?

mira (open-source): No runtime-breaking changes for traffic. One public API rename: `Adapter.load_checkpoint(...)` -> `Adapter.from_checkpoint(...)`. We emitted deprecation warnings in 0.0.x; migration guide here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference-adapters/blob/main/MIGRATION.md

leo (docs): I'll push updated examples and a snippet for using the adapter with streaming in Hosted mode. ETA today EOD.

rachel (engineering manager): Heads-up: community office hours tonight 18:00 PT to walk through adapter use-cases and onboarding new maintainers. Sign-up: https://meet.example.com/redwood-oss — please share with community channels.

oliver (docs): Quickstart + troubleshooting section added: https://docs.redwood.com/adapters/quickstart — includes example for Hosted + Dedicated and a note about quantization compatibilities.

mira (open-source): We're also recruiting 1-2 volunteer maintainers to help triage issues and review PRs. Maintainer checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md — DM me if interested or ping folks in the wider community.

community-bot: New issue triage label applied to #153 — request volunteers to pick it up.

dan (eng-runtime): I'll join office hours and run the Dedicated integration tests against v0.1.0 tomorrow.

mira (open-source): Thanks everyone. Please star :star: the repo, share in relevant channels, and drop any urgent regressions here.
